_comment: Append-only spend ledger for the editorial automation. Every AI run (research/editorial/validation) appends one entry. check-budget.js sums entries in the current calendar month and compares against automation-config.json budget block. This file is the audit trail for cost: which run, which model, which role, estimated USD, and why. Never hand-edit entries; the runner appends them. The 'months' rollup is a convenience cache the runner may refresh; the 'entries' array is the source of truth.
